kind: manual editorial review adapted from Faceless OS to original fiction
A: First sentence presents concrete immediate danger; short hook maps supermarket four accesses/thirty days or stolen car/seven days station dismantling to the body. Invented calendar explicitly fiction, not real statistics.
B: Escalation driven by consequences: Patch loses front refuge and escapes along established canal; Reed observes changing equipment route and leaves as building is dismantled. Each map/tool/route is planted before departure. Endings close refuge and car/key promises.
C: Pure English TTS narration; no visual tags, timestamps, copied transcript hooks, hypothetical medical quantities or unsourced expert attribution. No rigid cliffhanger or promo CTA.
D: Ordinary second-person action and observation, varied sentences; no cinematic prophecy or abstract moral. Compare anchor movement then consequence to concrete script actions; no attempt to clone a narrator identity.
D5: Dates/days and counts of entrances/pumps are authored fictional world rules, not claims about real disaster survival. No real statistics used.
E: Original distinct stories and drawn actions; source anchors teach shared spoken register only. No guarantee of views or retention. Fiction is labelled in package.
